pages.text: Upon consumption, grants the eater:$(br)$(li)1 minute of Doom XX$(li)The next apostle summoning will inevitably attract the world's gaze.

You have gained the Dark Sovereign's approval, deemed worthy of the badge of judgment. The omen of doom pulses in your hands, yet your thoughts pour into the cooking pot.$(br)Perhaps through certain means, the omen of doom can be transformed into another form—no matter whose head this final judgment descends upon.$(br)$(br)Therefore keep watch, because you do not know on what day your Lord will come. — Matthew
